text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Netanyahu concerned about possible parliamentary majority for changing direct election law.
- Mubarak: I dissuaded Arafat from leaving Gaza and taking up residence in Cairo.
- Initiative among religious parties to condition support for Netanyahu on passage of conversion law.
- Ben Gurion airport to shut down tonight if illegal radio transmissions are not halted.
- Legal adviser in prime minister's office: Jewish prayer on Jerusalem's Temple Mount was never banned.
- Government to sell Yozma for 50 million shekels.
- Banks petition High Court over Friday closure ban.
- Palestinians say the withdrawal is too small.
- Army in campaign against sexual harassment.
- Israeli withdrawal delayed over Palestinian protest.
- The commander of an air force base nearly downed a civilian airliner.
